title: Independent Boolean flags expand the test space
method: Exact illustrative combinatorics: 2^n for n = 2, 4, and 8 independent Boolean flags. Counts configurations, not reachable production states or defects; constraints can reduce the valid set.
alt: Independent Boolean flags expand the test space. Illustrative values: 2 Boolean flags 4 combinations, 4 Boolean flags 16 combinations, 8 Boolean flags 256 combinations.
